title: Stablecoin Runs as Safe-Asset Stress Signals: Episode-Level Evidence for Central Bank Surveillance
abstract: arXiv:2611.26180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper asks whether stablecoin runs carry information about U.S. Treasury yields. Using daily data on USDT, USDC and BUSD from 2021 to 2025 and five stress episodes, it measures flows from changes in token units rather than market capitalisation, which removes the phantom inflows the standard measure records when tokens lose their peg. Flows have no stable relationship with yields in normal periods. During the three panic-driven runs, a one-billion-dollar five-day redemption is associated with an 8.5 basis point fall in the three-month bill yield within ten trading days, while two regulatory episodes carry no such signal. The response is broad across maturities and has the opposite sign to what reserve liquidation predicts, which points to flight to quality. translated_title: 稳定币挤兑作为安全资产压力信号：面向央行监测的事件层面证据
translated_abstract: 本文探讨稳定币挤兑是否包含有关美国国债收益率的信息。利用2021年至2025年USDT、USDC和BUSD的每日数据以及五个压力事件，本文通过代币数量的变化而非市值来衡量资金流，从而消除了标准度量方法在代币脱锚时所记录的虚假流入。在正常时期，资金流与收益率之间不存在稳定关系。在三次恐慌驱动的挤兑事件中，十亿美元规模的五日赎回与三个月期国库券收益率在十个交易日内下降8.5个基点相关，而两次监管事件则未呈现此类信号。该响应广泛存在于各期限，且方向与储备清算所预测的相反，这表明存在向优质资产逃逸（flight to quality）的行为。该效应主要由TerraUSD崩盘事件驱动，并得到USDC/SVB挤兑的印证。恐慌期间约20亿至30亿美元的五日赎回标志着稳定币（挤兑）达到具有信号意义的规模临界点……
tldr: 本文创新性地以代币数量而非市值衡量稳定币资金流，发现恐慌性挤兑期间的大额赎回包含美国国债收益率的预警信息——每十亿美元五日赎回与三个月期国库券收益率十个交易日内下降8.5个基点相关，为央行监测提供了事件层面的证据。
en_tdlr: Measuring stablecoin flows by token units rather than market capitalization, this paper shows that large redemptions during panic-driven runs—about 8.5 basis points of three-month bill yield decline per billion dollars within ten trading days—serve as safe-asset stress signals useful for central bank surveillance.
